Class LessonsLearnedList

java.lang.Object
entityClasses.LessonsLearnedList
public class LessonsLearnedList extends Object

Title: LessonsLearnedList Class

Description: This class holds any group of lessons learned. The same class is used for the complete collection of lessons (every lesson stored in the lessonDB table, as returned by Database.getAllLessons) and for any subset of that collection: one contributor's lessons, or the lessons that match a search keyword. A subset is always a new LessonsLearnedList, so the collection it was taken from is never changed by building it.

Storage: the lessons are kept in an ArrayList. The TP2 requirements say a collection or subset may hold zero, one, or many lessons with no arbitrary maximum, and an ArrayList grows as needed, keeps the order the lessons were added (the database returns them oldest first), and gives direct access by position, which the Contributor page uses when the user selects a row in its list. A fixed-size array would have forced an artificial upper limit.

Empty message: the list also carries the message to show when it is empty, so the user interface does not need to know which operation produced it ("You have not added any lessons yet." for a contributor's lessons, "No lessons match your search." for a search).

Subset rules: the subset operations follow the rules already used by the rest of the system so a subset built here gives the same result as the database query for the same request.

  • subsetByAuthor keeps the lessons whose author is exactly the given username, which is how Database.getLessonsByAuthor and LessonManager decide which lessons a contributor owns.
  • subsetByKeyword keeps the lessons whose title or description contains the keyword, ignoring case, which matches Database.searchLessonsByAuthor and test cases TC-17 and TC-18. The author and category are deliberately not searched. Empty search text keeps every lesson, which matches TC-20.

How this supports the Contributor functions: the Contributor "Show All" and "Search" actions display a LessonsLearnedList, the empty message explains an empty result, and findById lets the page locate the lesson behind a selected row. The class depends only on the public getters of LessonsLearned, so attributes added to that class later can be used by new subset methods here without changing the existing ones.

    • LessonsLearnedList

      public LessonsLearnedList(LessonsLearnedList source)

      Method: LessonsLearnedList(LessonsLearnedList source)

      Description: Establishes a new list holding the same lessons, in the same order, and the same empty message as the source list. The new list has its own ArrayList, so adding to either list later does not change the other. The lesson objects themselves are shared, not duplicated, because both lists describe the same stored lessons.

      Parameters:
      source - the list to copy; a null source produces an empty list with no message

    • LessonsLearnedList

      public LessonsLearnedList()

      Method: LessonsLearnedList()

      Description: Establishes an empty list with no empty-list message. Merged in from the duplicate list class this one replaces, for callers that build a list without a message.

    • subsetByKeyword

      public LessonsLearnedList subsetByKeyword(String keyword, String emptyMessage)

      Method: LessonsLearnedList subsetByKeyword(String keyword, String emptyMessage)

      Description: Builds the subset of this list whose title or description contains the keyword, ignoring case and the spaces at the ends of the keyword. Empty search text keeps every lesson. The length limit on search text is checked by LessonValidator before a search is made, so it is not repeated here.

      Parameters:
      keyword - the text to look for in titles and descriptions
      emptyMessage - the message the subset shows if it is empty
      Returns:
      a new list with the matching lessons, in their original order (it may be empty)
